Sekhiya 3 (*Suppaṭicchanna-sikkhāpada*, translated as "Not being well-covered") is a monastic training rule belonging to the Sekhiya section of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* within the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule regulates proper decorum regarding monastic dress, requiring a monk to be suitably covered and robed when entering inhabited areas. An English translation of the rule has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
